summary: Frontend-only QA of dynamic Marca/Clasificación filtering in QuoteWizardDialog 'Modelo de Pinpad/POS' select. All 4 scenarios (VPOS, VPOS_MULTIRIF, FAST_TRACK, MPOS) filtered correctly by brand and asset_type=Bien; RESET DINÁMICO on quote_type change works; no Servicios or wrong-brand leaks; empty-state message logic present.
critical_code_review_comments: QuoteWizardDialog.jsx marcaForType() + applyMarca() cleanly derives visiblePinpads / visiblePosDevices / visibleFastTrackDevices. Correct exclusion of asset_type != 'Bien' (Servicios) and enforcement of Verifone / MoreFun per quote_type.
useEffect on quoteData.quote_type correctly resets pinpad_id when current selection is not in the new allowed list. Behaves correctly for FastTrack ('') and VPOS/MPOS ('none' placeholder).
Empty-state SelectItem 'No existen modelos disponibles para esta tecnología' is rendered when visible list is empty (verified conditional).
Minor: The filter uses hw.marca strict equality; make sure catalog seeds always store 'Verifone' / 'MoreFun' with exact casing (already validated via seeded QA rows).
seed_data_creation: None - used existing catalog (QA Verifone PP, QA MoreFun PP, QA MoreFun POS, Morefun MF*, PinPad Verifone VX/P200)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wizard is opened via 'Implementaciones' button → dropdown → 'Clientes Pymes' (or 'Clientes Corporativos'). Client selection needed BEFORE hardware section is populated. Pinpad selector is data-testid='select-pinpad'. Quote type selector is data-testid='select-quote-type'. All 7 acceptance criteria in the review passed.
